what: `design-init-runparams.sh` handoff lacks exit-code guards parallel to `design-route.sh`
scenario_or_breakage: Proposed SKILL rewrite only handles `INIT_STATUS=contract-drift` after the init fence; driver spec allows exit 2 for argv/config (`plan.txt:187`) and exit 1 for contract drift. On exit 2 or unexpected non-zero without a reliable result env, orchestrator may continue Step 0b as if init succeeded (same class as failure mode 6 for route, but unmitigated for init).
suggested_fix: Add `set +e` / `_init_rc` capture mirroring `plan.txt:204-209`: abort `/design` on exit 2 (configuration error banner) and on any other non-zero except the explicit contract-drift path; read `.design-init-runparams-result.env` only when `_init_rc=0`. Pin in `scripts/test-design-structure.sh` alongside FINDING_3 route greps.
